findings.issue: Contradictory new remote-image URI alias lists silently selected one value.
findings.resolution: Constructor now rejects differing URI values/order/length, permits equal separate lists, and exposes one immutable list through both getters.

qualification_boundary: No tests, screenshots, provider calls, CI requests, source edits, config changes, or ref mutations were performed in this review.
Targeted gate results are pending; development analysis is not relabeled as final acceptance.
Final reader publication enforces the full cumulative decoded-byte limit; fetch batches also have their own cumulative limit and may acquire an image that final reader admission refuses.
reviewed_behaviors: Autoconnect occurs only after adopting saved credentials; queued ticket captures settings, credential generation, store revision, session and selected account and rejects stale/disabled/manual/disposed ownership.
Cumulative remote admission counts both decoded body alternatives, all original attachment bytes, and previously accepted remote bytes; actual PNG/JPEG dimensions determine pixel admission.
Existing incremental append, one-pass input, URI-specific blocked placeholders, preformatted spacing and CID/external re-admission semantics are retained.
Selection/enabled aliases reject contradictions; remote-candidate aliases now reject contradictions as well.

Reader-owning loader compatibility API uses the same bounded loop as the original client-owning function, refuses redirects, bounds chunk copies and total response deadline, and cancels stalled/late bodies.
Native response publication checks captured reader revision and host/session identity; cleanup intentionally uses host identity after successful addImages increments reader revision.
